title: crepis polytricha
intro: Crepis polytricha, commonly known as the bitter lettuce or sea dandelion, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to treat digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and support liver health. The therapeutic actions of Crepis polytricha are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic properties, which are thought to be due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Crepis polytricha have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antiproliferative, and pro-apoptotic activities, further supporting its potential use in traditional medicine.
